breakdown.description: The 2D line traction on the top edge is reinterpreted as a 3D surface pressure
breakdown.reason: The agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction. The generated specification states to interpret the load as 'a pressure of 2000 Pa acting on the top face', which is the exact error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth corrects this to be interpreted as a '2D line traction per unit out-of-plane thickness'.
